question.text: The displacement of a particle at time $t$ is $x$, where $x=t^4-k t^3$. If the velocity of the particle at time $t=2$ is minimum, then

solution.text:
Hints : $\frac{d x}{d t}=4 t^3-3 k t^2$
$\frac{d v}{d t}=12 t^2-6 \mathrm{kt}$ at $\mathrm{t}=2$
$\Rightarrow \frac{\mathrm{dv}}{\mathrm{dt}}=0,48-12 \mathrm{k}=0 \quad ; \mathrm{k}=4$
